notes.title: The first MAJOR update to the game is now live!
notes.content:
Lots of major improvements have been implemented. The two most notable additions to the game includes keyboard support and single player mode.

It's now completely possible to control the entire game with keyboard and mouse, if you should want to. Besides making the game available to more people, this means two major things:
[olist]
 You never have to plug in a controller to play the game, if you want to experience the single player mode.
 You can play the game in multi-player mode even if you only have one gamepad.
[/olist]

Every map in the game can now be played in single player mode. This update also brings a completely new mode, that can't be played in multiplayer mode. Single player also brings CPU-controlled bots, which makes for an exciting experience even when your friends are unable to join your session.

I hope that you will enjoy this update! I look forward to hearing your feedback.
